newMessages.content: One possibility is to use the strongest model for every semantic mutation decision, although that would maximize inference cost.

I don't think every packet needs Claude. Once we have enough evaluation data, maybe a smaller classifier could handle the obvious same-object or child cases, and only ambiguous cases should get escalated to Claude. Claude could still be the fallback.

semanticPacket.conciseMeaning: The user proposes tiered semantic-model routing where a smaller classifier handles obvious object decisions and ambiguous cases escalate to Claude.
